title: 第14章 女尸的袭击第15章 接取任务
content_zh:
：服务员听见我的话语之后，便听见服务员踏着皮鞋的声音离开了我的房门。
而这时坐在一旁的刘倩倩一脸热情的盯着我，仿佛在贪婪的盯着一只受伤的猎物。
我被盯的脸色有些发红，急忙扯开话题问道：“要不你先教我一下这个桃木剑的使…”
话还没有说完，刘倩倩一把把我按压在床上，贪婪的盯着我的双眼问道：“想和我做吗？”
我听了之后不假思索的点了点头，身体血液开始沸腾，慢慢的躁动了起来，准备挣脱刘倩倩反手把他压在下面。
可我无论怎么用尽依旧身体丝毫动弹一分，而刘倩倩则是抿着双唇慢慢的向我脸颊袭来，而我也准备回应上去。
“砰！”
就在这时，我房门被一脚踹开！
我发现门口居然站着另一个刘倩倩，那现在在我身上的是？我瞬间吓得满头大汗，一脚踢飞眼前压在我身上的刘青青，身体随即向后一翻滚下了床，手脚并用的，急忙爬到了门口。
被我一脚踢飞出去的刘倩倩挣扎的从地上爬了起，脸上的皮肤开始逐渐脱落，露出了原本的面容，正是一具女尸。
一旁的刘倩倩看见眼前的女尸，火气顿时冲了上来，从背后掏出符咒默念道：“惶惶天威何处寻，阳光尽灭八怪云．天地雷极阳欲动，八宝五雷下云霄．火灼一切阴恶物，雷惩一切穷恶徒，急急如律令！”
女尸见状刚准备逃离，身体却被无名大火吞噬了起来！
“啊！”
火焰之中的女尸传来嘶吼，身体不断的拍打着周围，可没过多久，便停止了动作，灰飞烟灭了，仿佛从没有出现过。
“你是怎么知道？”
我一脸羞愧的站在刘倩倩的旁边，声音带着一丝心虚的问。
刘倩倩听了之后表情不悦的看着我，眼神中带着一丝愤怒，怨怨的说道：“我刚刚察觉到了，你的房间传来一股恐怖的怨气，并且在门口喊你许久，你一直没有开门，索性一脚踢开，便看见开头的那一幕！”
我听了之后，羞愧的低下头，我居然天真的以为刘倩倩会对我做这种事情，自己的小命差点又在这玩完了。
“对了，这个东西你带着吧，下次如果不确定是不是我把这个东西抹在眼睛上”
刘倩倩从包里面拿出一瓶带有血的小瓶，递给了我。

“这到底是什么东西？为什么你和赵史都会有这种东西？”
我满脸疑问的盯着刘倩倩。
刘倩倩听了之后淡淡的解释着：“这东西是将死之人的血液制作的，一般人在临死前会胡言乱语，并不是因为他们疯了，而是他们看见常人看不见的东西了，而使用他们的血液抹在双眼之上也能达到这种效果。”
我听了之后胃里一阵翻江倒海，我之前居然用将死之人的血液抹在了双眼之上，想到这里，我忍不住的像一旁的垃圾桶吐了出来。
不知吐了多久，感觉胃里的胃酸都被我吐了出来，双腿发软，渐渐的远离了垃圾桶。
刘倩倩看着我的样子嗤笑：“就这种东西就接受不了了吗？真的有这么令人作呕吗？”
content_en:
: After the waiter heard my words, he heard the sound of the waiter stepping on his leather shoes and leaving my door.
At this time, Liu Qianqian, who was sitting next to me, stared at me passionately, as if she was greedily staring at a wounded prey.
My face turned a little red as I was being stared at, so I quickly changed the topic and asked, "How about you teach me how to use this peach wood sword first..."
Before I finished speaking, Liu Qianqian pushed me down on the bed, stared into my eyes greedily and asked, "Do you want to do it with me?"
After hearing this, I nodded without thinking. The blood in my body began to boil, and I slowly became restless. I was ready to break away from Liu Qianqian and pin him down with her backhand.
But no matter how hard I tried, I still couldn't move my body at all, and Liu Qianqian pursed her lips and slowly attacked my cheek, and I was ready to respond.
"Bang!"
At this moment, my door was kicked open!
I found another Liu Qianqian standing at the door. So who is on top of me now? I was so frightened that I was sweating profusely. I kicked away Liu Qingqing, who was pressing on me, and rolled my body backwards out of bed. Using my hands and feet, I hurriedly climbed to the door.
Liu Qianqian, who was kicked away by me, struggled to get up from the ground. The skin on her face began to peel off, revealing her original face, which was that of a female corpse.
When Liu Qianqian saw the female corpse in front of her, she immediately became angry. She took out the talisman from her back and recited silently: "Where can I find the power of heaven in panic? The sun will destroy the eight strange clouds. The thunder in the sky and the earth is about to move, and the eight treasures and five thunders will descend into the sky. Fire will burn all evil things, and thunder will punish all poor villains. It is as urgent as the law!"
When the female corpse saw this, she was about to flee, but her body was devoured by an unknown fire!
"Ah!"
The female corpse in the flames screamed, and her body kept slapping the surroundings. But not long after, it stopped moving and disappeared into ashes, as if it had never appeared.
"How did you know?"
I stood next to Liu Qianqian with a face of shame and asked with a hint of guilt in my voice.
After hearing this, Liu Qianqian looked at me with an unhappy expression, with a trace of anger in her eyes, and said resentfully: "I just noticed that there was a terrible resentment coming from your room, and she called you at the door for a long time, but you never opened the door, so you kicked it open and saw the scene at the beginning!"
After hearing this, I lowered my head in shame. I actually naively thought that Liu Qianqian would do such a thing to me, and my life almost ended here again.
"By the way, you should take this thing with you. If you are not sure next time, I will put this thing on your eyes."
Liu Qianqian took out a vial with blood from her bag and handed it to me.
"What on earth is this? Why do you and Zhao Shi both have this kind of thing?"
I stared at Liu Qianqian with doubts on my face.
After hearing this, Liu Qianqian explained calmly: "This thing is made from the blood of a dying person. Most people talk nonsense before they die, not because they are crazy, but because they see things that ordinary people cannot see. This effect can also be achieved by applying their blood on the eyes."
After hearing this, I felt a surge in my stomach. I had actually smeared my eyes with the blood of a dying person before. Thinking of this, I couldn't help but spit it out like a trash can nearby.
I don’t know how long I had vomited, but I felt like all the acid in my stomach had been vomited out. My legs became weak and I gradually moved away from the trash can.
Liu Qianqian looked at me and sneered: "Can't you just accept this kind of thing? Is it really so disgusting?"
